admission.justification: Predicate and ordering tests pin the marking and the newest-first order with revert-verified failure; the obligation spans the writer predicate, the shared ordering helper and both surfaces in four files.

applicability: Every decision log surface: the task-page preview and the whole-log reader page.
conditions: Both order by parsed recorded time, newest first; invalid stamps sort after all valid stamps, stable among invalid peers (never inventing order).
The preview shows the five newest authored decisions with an all-entries link naming both counts; product-written records are muted from the authored count.
Product-record marking comes only from the writers' own constants via exact/prefix match; authored collisions are unguarded (no enforced separation).
exclusions: Storage order carries no invariant; neither surface invents an order.
The stored decision shape is unchanged by the marking.

evidence: predicate tests + preview tests + whole-log unsorted test; pytest/vitest green

statement: Decision logs show the five newest authored decisions by recorded time with an all-entries link naming both counts, and the whole log opens newest-first by time on its own reader page with product-written records muted.
